title: Gandora on Shining Sarcophagus
summary: The Gandora dragons built on the Shining Sarcophagus engine that Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction belongs to, plus staples and an automatic Extra Deck. While Shining Sarcophagus is on the field, Gandora-G Special Summons itself from the hand, wipes and banishes every other card on the field, and calls a Sarcophagus companion from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gadget Trio searches Shining Sarcophagus or any Spell/Trap that mentions it on Normal or Special Summon.
Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice Special Summons itself from the hand by discarding a card and searches Shining Sarcophagus on summon.
Shining Sarcophagus cannot be destroyed by monster effects and searches any card that mentions it once per turn, including Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction or Future Silence.

Future Silence searches any monster that mentions Shining Sarcophagus, and if activated during the Battle Phase while you control Shining Sarcophagus and a monster that mentions it, both players draw until they hold 6 cards.

summary.title: Opening: Gadget Trio or Apprentice into Gandora-G
steps: Normal Summon Gadget Trio (or Special Summon Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice) to search Shining Sarcophagus.
Activate Shining Sarcophagus and use its effect to search Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction (or Ties That Bind if you already hold Gandora-G).
Going first, summon Silent Magician Zero and Silent Swordsman Zero via Ties That Bind to establish Spell and targeting negation; going second, Special Summon Gandora-G from the hand.
Pay half your LP with Gandora-G to destroy and banish all other cards on the field, then Special Summon Archfiend's Advent or Silent Magician Zero from the Deck.

summary.title: The Gandora Dragons
points: Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction Special Summons itself from the hand while you control Shining Sarcophagus, gains 300 ATK for each banished card, and pays half your LP to destroy and banish every other card on the field (except Shining Sarcophagus, which is immune to monster destruction) before summoning a Level 7 or lower Sarcophagus monster from the Deck and raising its Level by the number of cards destroyed.

Gandora the Dragon of Destruction cannot be Special Summoned; when Normal or Flip Summoned, it pays half your LP to destroy and banish as many other cards on the field as possible and gains 300 ATK per card destroyed.

Gandora-X the Dragon of Demolition, when Normal or Special Summoned from the hand, destroys as many other monsters on the field as possible, inflicts burn damage equal to the highest ATK among them, and sets its ATK to that amount (paying half your LP each End Phase).

summary.title: Shining Sarcophagus Companions & Control
points: Silent Magician Zero negates an opponent's Spell effect while you control Shining Sarcophagus and raises its Level and ATK whenever the opponent draws.
Silent Swordsman Zero negates effects that target Shining Sarcophagus or monsters that mention it, growing in Level and ATK every Standby Phase.
Archfiend's Advent Normal Summons without Tributing while you control Shining Sarcophagus and takes control of an opponent's monster until the End Phase.

Turn Silence raises a monster's Level by 3 (boosting Silent Magician Zero or Swordsman Zero by 1500 ATK) and negates an opponent's monster effect while you control Shining Sarcophagus and a monster that mentions it.
Stronghold the Hidden Fortress Special Summons itself as a Trap Monster, gains 1000 ATK per monster you control that mentions Shining Sarcophagus, and destroys an attacking monster once per turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Gigarays Gandora the Dragon of Destruction has not been released in the TCG.
